desc:
🌲 DONT FOLLOW 🌲

A distress call came in from a farmhouse at the edge of Greyhaven Valley.
Then the line went dead.

You've been sent to find out what happened.

The house is empty. The doors are locked from the inside.
And someone left a warning behind...

🕯️ 1–4 players
🎧 Headphones recommended
🌑 Play in the dark

Gather in the lodge. Choose your party.
Stay together.

And whatever you hear out there...
don't follow.

⚠️ Contains jumpscares and frightening scenes.
👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite if you made it back.
